Throughout her whole history, Israel's prophets were tortured, mocked, scourged, imprisoned, stoned, sawn asunder, and slain. (Heb. 11:35-38.) For instance: Jeremiah was beaten and imprisoned (Jer. 37:15-21; 38:6); Zechariah the son of Jehoiada was stoned (2 Chron. 24:18-22); Urijah the son of Shemaiah was slain (Jer. 26:20-24), as were other prophets (Neh. 9:26); and according to tradition, Isaiah was sawn asunder.
